profile.name: Hamza Rehman
profile.headline: Creative
profile.bio: I’m Hamza. I design and build modern websites, interactive 3D experiences, and AI-powered digital products.
profile.about:
A designer’s eye. A developer’s mind.

I’m a Computer Science student at Pak-Austria Fachhochschule – IAST. I design and build modern web experiences, explore interactive 3D, and use AI and automation to turn ideas into working products.

Web × AI × 3D × Product Design
profile.contactDescription: Have a project in mind? Tell me a little about it.
profile.metaDescription: Explore Hamza Rehman’s work in full-stack development, immersive 3D websites, design, and AI automation.

testimonials.name: Taimoor Khan
testimonials.text:
Hamza ne hamare gym ke liye complete management web application develop ki, jisme QR scanning, member accounts aur admin controls sab kuch bohat smoothly kaam karta hai. Bohat professional aur reliable work.

Translation:
Hamza developed a complete gym management web application for us with QR scanning, member accounts, and powerful admin controls. Everything works smoothly and professionally.

testimonials.text:
Hamza ne hamare gym ke liye unique logo aur premium gym membership cards design kiye jo hamare brand ko bohat professional look dete hain. Bohat hi creative aur visual design kaam hai.

Hamza designed a unique logo and premium gym membership cards for our gym which gives our brand a highly professional look. Truly creative and visual design work.
